firm_data.firm_name: Kagan Lubic Lepper Finkelstein & Gold, LLP
firm_data.firm_description: Kagan Lubic Lepper Finkelstein & Gold, LLP is a full-service AV–rated law firm providing practical and legal counsel to clients for over forty years. A substantial portion of their practice is centered on real estate and cooperative and condominium law, including reconstruction/ Local Law compliance, landmark preservation, Mitchell-Lama/HDFC housing law, business law, litigation and alternate dispute resolution.
notable_facts: The firm has specialized in cooperative and condominium law for over forty years.
They serve as general counsel to over 150 cooperatives and condominiums.

email.subject: AI for KLLF&G, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jack,

Your 40 years of depth in cooperative and condominium law, including the complex Local Law compliance and landmark preservation work, positions KLLF&G uniquely in the market. That specialization also means handling high-volume compliance reviews and documentation for your 150+ condo and co-op clients creates real operational friction.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like ourselves are helping similar practices compete. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how Lucio handles the document-heavy work your clients depend on.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
